items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: And then Maria Schneider was telling me, we did some big band, we split a big band concert

ctx.x: Yeah Latin percussion. Ten years old. That was this year. And then Maria Schneider was telling me, we did some big band, we split a big band concert, and she was telling me about this horn player from Sicily that was like ten or eleven years old, just kind of leading this whole band and having incredible knowledge of how to make the rhythm section, which was not together, sound like it was together. And I’m like okay it was teenagers, now they’re going down into the single digits. Like the wind chill this winter.
Yeah, wow. You wonder if they’re not possessing someone’s spirit from—
